questions.question: <div style=\"text-align:justify\">If the polynomial x<sup>4<\/sup> + x<sup>3<\/sup> + ax<sup>2<\/sup> + bx + c is divisible by x<sup>2<\/sup> + x + 1 = 0, then find the value of 5a – b – 4c (a,b,c ∈ R)<\/div>$\n$
questions.explanation:
Let f(x) = x4 + x3 + ax2 + bx + c
$ $& x2 + x + 1 = (x + ω)(x + ω2)
$ \u$2235 f(x) is divisible by x2 + x + 1
$ $ f(ω) = 0 ⇒ ω + 1 + aω2 + bω + c = 0 .....(1)
$ f$(ω2) = 0 ⇒ ω2 + 1 + aω + bω2 + c = 0 ....(2)
$ eq$. (1) – eq. (2)
$ $⇒ ω – ω2 – a(ω – ω2) + b(ω – ω2) = 0
$ $⇒ 1 – a + b = 0 ⇒ a – b = 1 .....(3)
$ $& eq. (1) + eq. (2)
$ $⇒ (ω + ω2) + 2 + a(ω + ω2) + b(ω + ω2) + 2c = 0
$ $⇒ –a – b + 2c + 1 = 0
$ $⇒ 2c = a + b – 1 .....(4)
$ Now$, 5a – b – 4c = 5a – b – 2a –2b + 2
$ $= 3 (a –b) + 2 = 3 + 2 = 5
